title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theater on 1969-02-07
lineage: SBD > MC > DAT > HHb > CDR > EAC (secure) > CD Wave > Cool Edit Pro > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early ’69 show with a smoking Dark Star, William Tell, and an explosive Eleven>Lovelight, captured on a solid soundboard tape that has a bit of vintage hiss.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its intensity – Dark Star opens the night brooding and powerful, the Alligator > Caution sequence is called “one for the ages,” and the Eleven>Lovelight stretch is singled out as the extra‑tasty highlight. The recording comes from a cassette soundboard master: it’s well balanced with good clarity despite some tape hiss and occasional power‑loss quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance and the soundboard source indicate an excellent show with only minor tape‑hiss issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cassette master with vintage tape hiss; overall balanced mix, clear enough to hear details. Some reviewers note occasional power loss or drop‑outs but nothing that ruins the listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening Dark Star, followed by classic early‑’69 material; second set jams are described as superlative with tight transitions and high‑octane energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry's guitar “shooting sparks” and perfect tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is highlighted (“Phil bombs”) and hints of New Potato/13s in the Cryptical reprise are praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers (Bill) are said to “tear the roof off” with powerful, driving rhythms.
